_note: See Saw overlap preset, fitted 2026-09-02 against the 2026-09-01 LA snapshots (Featured 7 / Editor's Picks 10 / All 26) over the 189-show in-window pool. Search: 50k random + rounded-grid weight vectors, scored on nDCG@10 vs the Editor's Picks + precision@5/@10 vs the 26, under the constraint that every in-pool Featured show clears the threshold; the winner sits on a plateau (jitter-mean J 3.33 of a 3.37 peak under +/-25% weight noise), so the exact decimals are not load-bearing. Result on that snapshot: 6/6 in-pool Featured above threshold, 4/6 in the 12-show feed, P@5 1.00, P@10 0.80, and 4 of our 5 Editor's Picks are on See Saw's own Editor's Picks (vs P@5 0.43 / 2 of 6 Featured for seesaw-gallery.json). Why the weights look like this: judge (Sonnet+Opus mean, AUC 0.78 on Featured) is the strongest ranker - dropping it costs 1.36 J; quality is the strongest DENSE feature (AUC 0.72) and carries the shows with no verdict; venue tier only works with the raised tier_map below - on the default map (unknown 0.20) two Featured shows fall under the threshold; press is weak here (See Saw's gallery picks carry almost no press: 6 of 7 Featured have press < 0.15) so it drops 0.35 -> 0.14. keyword, closing_soon, wiki_heat and opening_recency are ZEROED because each measurably hurt the head of the list: keyword -0.35 J (it fires on institutional survey/retrospective language See Saw's gallery picks do not use, AUC 0.35), closing_soon -0.37 J, wiki_heat -0.28 J, opening_recency AUC 0.50 (noise). Restore them if you want a production feed that is timing-aware; they are off here only because this preset is fitted to the benchmark. exclude_museums is worth 1.36 J on its own (See Saw Featured is 0% museums; the pool is 35%). max_per_venue 2 mirrors See Saw, which lists up to 2 shows per venue. CEILING: the last two Featured shows (Vielmetter 'Ongoingness', Karma 'Dictation from the Other Side') cannot be reached by ANY non-negative weighting - they are Pareto-dominated on all ten features by 16 and 13 other in-window shows respectively (13 and 9 of those are not on See Saw), because neither has a judge verdict, press signal, wiki article or venue tier. Fixing them is a data job, not a weights job: judge coverage is 48 of 321 pool shows, and venue tier is None for 1081 of 1108 LA venues including Karma, Vielmetter and Ghebaly.
